disclaimer: DCDE program names, application windows, and prize amounts change frequently. Verify with the chamber before applying.

chamber.parent: Dubai Chambers (one of three: Commerce, International, Digital)
chamber.leadership_note: Dubai Media Office (7 October 2026) and DCDE (20 September 2026) releases title Omar Sultan Al Olama as Chairman and Saeed Al Gergawi as Vice President of the Dubai Chamber of Digital Economy.
chamber.contact_note: Phone numbers rechecked on dubaichamberdigital.com on 2026-10-13; the email address is obfuscated on the site and was not re-verified.

membership.summary: DCDE has no standalone membership scheme (rechecked October 2026). Founders engage via specific programmes (Dubai Founders HQ, Antler residency, FRWRDx, Create AI Agents, Business Matching).

dubai_chamber_of_commerce_separate.mandatory_for: DET licensees conducting listed commercial, industrial, agricultural, professional, or service activities, subject to statutory exemptions
dubai_chamber_of_commerce_separate.free_zone_membership: A free zone establishment may join after approval of its supervising free zone authority.
dubai_chamber_of_commerce_separate.fee_note: The official schedule varies by legal form, owner nationality, and activity; AED 50 (simple handicrafts) and AED 2,200 (e.g. free zone companies, banks, branches of foreign companies) are category endpoints, not universal fees. The renewal page header summarises fees as AED 300 to AED 2,200 while its detailed schedule still lists AED 50; members of the Mohammed Bin Rashid Establishment for SME Development get a 5-year exemption (rechecked 2026-10-13).

programs.name: Dubai Founders HQ
programs.description: Phygital (physical + digital) platform connecting Dubai founders to ecosystem resources, mentorship, and government services. Campus at the 25hours Hotel, One Central, Dubai World Trade Centre.
programs.url_note: dubaifoundershq.com returned HTTP 403 to automated checks on 2026-10-13 (bot blocking, not confirmed dead); launch facts verified from Dubai Media Office.

programs.name: Antler Founder Residency
programs.operator: DET + DCDE (through Dubai Founders HQ) + Antler
programs.description: Multi-year partnership delivering Antler's Residency Program from Dubai Founders HQ, plus Antler's Academy, for early-stage founders. Dubai Media Office says more than 600 founders are expected to be upskilled. Current cohort dates were not published.

programs.name: FRWRDx
programs.description: 14-week hybrid experience for aspiring and early-stage founders, with practical business-building, mentorship and AI tools. The official FAQ explicitly says it is neither a course nor an accelerator.
programs.current_status: Register-interest form available. The published cohort schedule remains 15 September to 21 December 2025 (page last updated 13 October 2025); no new dated cohort was verified (rechecked 13 October 2026).
programs.cost_note: Dubai Chambers describes sponsoring committed participants; confirm the offered seat and current terms.

programs.name: Unicorn 30 Programme
programs.description: Programme developed by DCDE with about 80 local and international companies to fast-track 30 emerging companies in new economic sectors towards billion-dollar valuations, under the Dubai Founders HQ umbrella. Approved by Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed at the second 2025 meeting of the Higher Committee for Future Technology Development and the Digital Economy. No application window was found.

programs.name: Create Apps Championship

current_cycle.finalist_teams_source_note: 12 finalists per the official page (announced 14 April 2026).

programs.notes: Cycle 3 finals were held on 7 October 2026. The Championship is succeeded by the Create AI Agents Championship launched the same day; no Cycle 4 of Create Apps is announced. See the createapps feature for the full timeline and results.
programs.prize_note: The official page states a pool of over USD 720,000. USD 150,000 per category winner is confirmed for the 2025 (second) edition by Dubai Media Office; the official Cycle 3 page does not restate the per-category amount.

programs.name: Create AI Agents Championship
categories: Best Youth AI Agent (lead participant under 21 at registration)
programs.prize_pool_note: Unresolved as of 2026-10-20. Dubai Media Office and the DCDE launch release cite a pool exceeding AED 2.5 million: AED 550,000 for each of four category winners, plus AED 1 million and the Dubai AI Agent of the Year title for one of them. The official championship FAQ states USD 750,000 in total grants, USD 150,000 per category winner, and unspecified additional funding for the AI Agent of the Year. No official source reconciles the two.
programs.eligibility_summary: Open worldwide to individuals and teams (up to 6 members), technical or non-technical, no minimum age; free to enter; ideas, prototypes and early MVPs accepted; submissions in English. Entrants submit an AI-agent prototype, pitch deck and demo video.
programs.registration_close_note: The official championship page (timeline and FAQ, rechecked 2026-10-20) now consistently says registration closes in January 2027; on 2026-10-13 its FAQ still said December 2026. The 7 October launch releases from Dubai Media Office and DCDE still say December 2026. Treat January 2027 as the organiser's current position, but register early because no exact day is published.

indicative_timeline.semi_finalists_announced: 2027-01 (24 teams), per both the official timeline and FAQ

programs.submission_status: Registration is open; the official page says registrants will be notified when submissions open.

participant_perks.lovable_platform_credits: Under a DCDE MoU signed on 19 October 2026, Lovable will provide platform credits, funded by Dubai Chambers, to Create AI Agents Championship participants. Amounts and how to claim them were not published.

programs.name: Agentic AI training for the private sector (Dubai Chambers Academy)
programs.description: Specialised Agentic AI training tracks on the new Dubai Chambers Academy e-learning platform for more than 14,000 member companies of the Business Groups and Business Councils under Dubai Chamber of Commerce. Part of the programme to transition Dubai's private sector towards Agentic AI, launched under the directives of Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed.

partners_2026_10_19.name: Nebius Academy
partners_2026_10_19.scope: AI leadership and Agentic AI training programmes through Dubai Chambers Academy, including training content, certifications, technical workshops and expert-led sessions for executives, technical teams and employees of Dubai Chamber of Commerce member companies.

partners_2026_10_19.name: Lovable
partners_2026_10_19.scope: Entrepreneurship and skills programmes, platform access and educational resources for Dubai-based companies and founders, joint events and workshops, and platform credits funded by Dubai Chambers for Create AI Agents Championship participants.

programs.eligibility_note: Aimed at Dubai Chamber of Commerce member companies in its Business Groups and Business Councils; no cost or formal eligibility rules were published.

programs.name: Canva Partnership
programs.target: 250,000 digital SMEs and individuals over five years
programs.description: Free one-year Canva Business subscription (design tools, templates, Brand Kits and AI features) for eligible Dubai SMEs, with up to 50 employees per company.
eligibility: No current or previous paid Canva subscription
programs.eligibility_note: DCDE says companies holding Dubai-issued trade licences will become eligible soon; the offer is accessed through the Business in Dubai platform.

programs.name: Investor pitching with Oraseya Capital (SANDBOX Investment Program)
programs.description: DCDE-arranged pitching session connecting digital startups with Oraseya Capital, the DIEZ investment arm. Its SANDBOX Investment Program cites potential investments of AED 550,000 to about AED 11 million plus mentorship; the fund manages AED 500 million for pre-seed to Series B technology startups.
programs.application_status: Participation was by DCDE selection; no open application window was published.

programs.name: Business Matching
programs.description: Matchmaking for tech companies with partners, investors and customers, plus institutional support services through the Dubai Chambers partner network: market entry, corporate services, introductions and funding opportunities. Companies submit a form; the team prepares match factsheets and sends introductory emails.

knowledge_hub.total_note: The Knowledge Hub listing showed 'Showing 1 to 10 of 25' on 2026-10-13; four titles are tracked here. The AI Playbook launch (29 July 2025) is confirmed by Dubai Media Office; its 52-page length comes from a single secondary source and was not re-verified.

impact_2025.source: DCDE January 2026 press release (Dubai Media Office, 22 January 2026; figures rechecked 2026-10-13)

last_refresh_scope: Targeted refresh of 2026-10-20: added the agentic_ai_private_sector_programme record (Dubai Chambers Academy Agentic AI training for 14,000+ member companies, launched 1 September 2026 per Dubai Media Office and WAM, plus the 19 October 2026 DCDE MoUs with Nebius Academy and Lovable from the DCDE newsroom). Create AI Agents Championship: the official FAQ now agrees with the timeline that registration closes and semi-finalists are announced in January 2027 (it said December 2026 and February 2027 respectively at the last review); the 7 October launch releases still say December 2026, so both are kept. The prize total remains unresolved (official FAQ USD 750,000 versus over AED 2.5 million in the releases). Lovable platform credits for participants added. Checked with no change: no DCDE newsroom item since 7 October other than the 19 October MoUs; Create Apps Cycle 3 record; programme URLs respond, except dubaifoundershq.com (HTTP 403 to automated checks, labelled, not removed). Not a full re-verification of every field in this pack; full_review_date is preserved.
